Harness the Power of GenAI with Microsoft and TCS

TCS AI Catapult Forward is a GenAI-powered software development platform for Microsoft Azure. It accelerates the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC) by using generative AI (GenAI) to streamline development, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.

  • Single integrated platform: a unified platform for architects, developers, testers, and cloud engineers to collaborate using context-aware prompts 
  • Guided development: pre-built prompt library assists in various stages of the SDLC, reducing the need for specialized skills and accelerating development  
  • Cost-efficient: lowers development costs by automating repetitive tasks and optimizing resource usage 
  • Cloud-native design patterns: supports adoption of cloud-native architectures through pre-configured building blocks aligned with Microsoft standards
